name: Dados de Bancos (Dev + Neo4j)
postStartCommand: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; from neo4j import GraphDatabase; d = GraphDatabase.driver('bolt://neo4j:7687', auth=('neo4j', 'banco1984')); [d.execute_query(c.strip(), database_='neo4j') for f in ['cypher/schema.cypher', 'cypher/data.cypher'] for c in '\n'.join(l for l in Path(f).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if not l.strip().startswith('//')).split(';') if c.strip()]; d.close(); print('Neo4j pronto e populado!')"
